title: Ten degree-100 cyclic fields at exponent 153.9 with actual-work profile budgets

claims.statement: The explicit ten-field degree-100 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-100 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 1404719304643696798689007504653/10000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=21306706949390502987836000332430252282142597733 primitives on every received word, with W^10<=2^1539.

experiments.purpose: Check field, Hamming rows, 227-operation cube and exact work (0), ten pair cutoffs and proper-run lengths 1–5 (1), 231 exact child weights (2), and proper-run lengths 6–9 and exact error (3).
